sections.heading: Escape from Tarkov
sections.text: Escape from Tarkov released on November 15, 2025. The game still gets frequently updated, as can be seen in the Changelog. It can be purchased on the official website or on Steam.

sections.heading: Past release dates
sections.text:
- Full Game Release: 15. November 2025
- Closed Beta: 27. July 2017
- Extended Alpha: 28. December 2016
- Closed Alpha: 4. August 2016

sections.heading: Escape from Tarkov: Arena
sections.text: Escape from Tarkov: Arena is currently in Closed Beta. The game gets frequently updated, as can be seen in the Changelog. To participate in the Closed Beta you can pre-order on the official website or in the Epic Games Store. Pre-orders are able to download and play immediately after purchase.
